songs.name: Together We Ride
songs.description: A soldiers' march that sets the pace of a column on the move. Steels the arm and sharpens the mind for the road ahead.

songs.name: Fodlan Winds
songs.description: A quick country reel that has every foot tapping before the second verse. Loosens the joints and steadies the hands.

songs.name: Destiny Ablaze
songs.description: A slow, warm cradle song from the lowland farms. Settles the body and braces it against the cold.

songs.name: Edge of Dawn
songs.description: A watchman's hymn sung through the small hours. Keeps weariness at bay and the spirit unshaken.

songs.name: Lost in Thoughts
songs.description: A flattering court air of the old capital. Everyone who hears it walks a little taller and speaks a little smoother.
